quiz.title: ST ANDREW'S EDITION
quiz.greeting: Happy St Andrew's Day! This week's questions have a Scottish flavour. Press red to begin.
quiz.share: I scored {score}/12 on Flummox!, the Teletext quiz on STEEVEFAX page 152. Can you flummox Felix?

verdicts.text: Felix is utterly FLUMMOXED! A perfect game.
Not bad. Felix has seen worse.
Felix is not flummoxed in the slightest.

questions.question: St Andrew is the patron saint of Scotland and which island nation?
questions.quip: Right! Barbados celebrates its independence on 30 November too.

questions.question: What is the Scottish flag, a white cross on blue, called?
What is Scotland's national animal?
questions.quip: Correct! Always shown in chains, just in case.

questions.question: In which city is the Royal Mile?
questions.quip: Yes! From the castle down to Holyrood.

questions.question: What is the highest mountain in the UK?
What is the longest river in Scotland?
Which Scot is credited with inventing the telephone?
Which Edinburgh-born author created Sherlock Holmes?
Which Dundee-made game had you saving green-haired creatures?
Which poet wrote the words of Auld Lang Syne?
Dolly the sheep, the first mammal cloned from an adult cell, was born near which city?
What is a haar, on Scotland's east coast?
questions.quip: Right! It rolls in off the North Sea.
